corpus.description: Verify whether unified_orchestrator_v7.py references quarantine/evidence columns
corpus.finding: Orchestrator does NOT check usable_as_evidence, war_period, origin, or quarantine columns. No evidence-centric module is imported.
corpus.pass_criteria: Orchestrator should check usable_as_evidence, war_period, origin

corpus.description: Count WWII internment links in WWI events database
corpus.finding: 12759 WWII internment links found in WWI events DB. These are 18 WWI events with WWII contamination.
corpus.pass_criteria: Zero cross-war links should exist

corpus.description: Check if collegamenti table has quarantine columns
corpus.finding: collegamenti has 2349417 rows but NO quarantine columns (usable_as_evidence, origin, war_period). These legacy entity links are completely unquarantined.
corpus.pass_criteria: collegamenti should have quarantine columns

corpus.description: Verify what validation the narrator performs
corpus.finding: Narrator uses NarrationEvidenceSelector + NarrationValidator (weaker validation). AnswerEvidenceGate and ClaimStatus are NOT imported. No verify_answer() call. No AnswerEvidenceBundle construction.
corpus.pass_criteria: Narrator should use AnswerEvidenceGate and ClaimStatus

corpus.description: Verify _stage_persist implementation
corpus.finding: _stage_persist is a no-op (pass). Snapshots are ephemeral. No evidence trail.
corpus.pass_criteria: _stage_persist should call evidence_snapshot_service

corpus.description: Verify graph_service checks quarantine columns
corpus.finding: graph_service checks algorithm_version and legacy_unverified but NOT usable_as_evidence, origin, or war_period. Quarantined links can appear as candidates in the graph.
corpus.pass_criteria: graph_service should check usable_as_evidence, origin, war_period

corpus.description: Verify V7.3 temporal/geographic barriers are in the decision path
corpus.finding: V7.3 barriers (temporal veto, geographic semantic roles) are NOT imported by orchestrator or narrator. They are only used by narration_planner_v73.py which is not in the main pipeline.
corpus.pass_criteria: Orchestrator or narrator should import barriers_v73

corpus.description: Count active cross-link field changes on internati records
corpus.finding: 40587 active cross-link field changes exist on internati records. These fields were overwritten from external sources (lebi, caduti, decorati) but the orchestrator does not distinguish original vs cross-linked fields.
corpus.pass_criteria: Cross-linked fields should be marked as derived/secondary evidence
corpus.note: Cross-linked fields are not flagged in the evidence pipeline. They appear as original data.

corpus.description: Verify EventOntologyService integration
corpus.finding: EventOntologyService is NOT imported by orchestrator or event_resolver. Orchestrator uses v7_event_aggregate (simpler model). Event_resolver uses hardcoded HIERARCHY dict.
corpus.pass_criteria: EventOntologyService should be used for event hierarchy validation

corpus.description: Verify SourceLineageService integration in fusion stage
corpus.finding: SourceLineageService is NOT imported by orchestrator or fusion engine. Fusion uses in-memory IndependenceAssessor (heuristic only). DB-backed lineage with authority levels is unused.
corpus.pass_criteria: Fusion should use DB-backed SourceLineageService

corpus.description: Verify temporal gate blocks cross-war contamination
corpus.finding: 12,759 WWII internment links exist in WWI events DB. None are blocked by the orchestrator (barriers_v73 not imported). war_period column is empty on all links. 0 links blocked by temporal gate.
corpus.pass_criteria: Zero cross-war links should reach the AI narrator

corpus.description: Verify source independence assessment method
corpus.finding: Fusion engine uses in-memory IndependenceAssessor with heuristic scoring. No DB lookup. No authority levels. No lineage IDs. Dependent sources (same archive, same OCR) may be counted as independent.
corpus.pass_criteria: Fusion should use DB-backed lineage for independence

corpus.description: Verify which claim statuses reach the AI narrator
corpus.finding: NarrationEvidenceSelector includes APPROVED, PROBABLE, NEEDS_REVIEW, and CONTEXT claims. REJECTED are excluded. But NEEDS_REVIEW claims (which include conflicting and unverified) are passed to AI as context. No AnswerEvidenceGate grouping by verification status. No blocking of unsupported claims stated as fact.
corpus.pass_criteria: Only APPROVED and PROBABLE claims should reach AI

corpus.description: Verify REJECTED claims are filtered in follow-up chat
corpus.finding: execute_followup passes ALL person_claims to AI without status filtering. No status check. No filter. REJECTED and UNSUPPORTED claims are included in the prompt. AI can narrate rejected claims as fact.
corpus.pass_criteria: REJECTED claims should be excluded from follow-up prompt

corpus.description: Quantify exposure of unquarantined collegamenti table
corpus.finding: 2,349,417 entity links in collegamenti with NO quarantine columns. All are accessible as candidates. No usable_as_evidence, origin, or war_period filtering. This is the largest unquarantined legacy table.
corpus.pass_criteria: collegamenti should have quarantine columns or be migrated

corpus.description: Verify scope of narrator's post-generation hallucination check
corpus.finding: Narrator's hallucination check covers: dates, places, names, temporal contamination (WWI/WWII). Does NOT check: rejected claims mentioned in output, unsupported claims stated as fact, provenance chain validation. These are exactly what AnswerEvidenceGate.verify_answer() would check.
corpus.pass_criteria: Hallucination check should cover all evidence gate violations
corpus.note: The narrator's check is a subset of what AnswerEvidenceGate provides.

corpus.description: Verify war_period column is populated on legacy links
corpus.finding: war_period is EMPTY on all 1539685 event_links and all 169184 record_links. The column exists but was never populated during quarantine migration. The orchestrator doesn't check it anyway (Test B).
corpus.pass_criteria: war_period should be set on all links

corpus.description: Analyze what 'VERIFIED' means in the claim rules
corpus.finding: classify_claim_status maps statuses to APPROVED/PROBABLE/NEEDS_REVIEW/REJECTED/CONTEXT. APPROVED is assigned to claims with status ACCEPTED or SUPPORTED and confidence >= 0.7. No check for evidence_ids, provenance_chain, or independent sources. A single-source claim with confidence 0.7 can be APPROVED.
corpus.pass_criteria: VERIFIED should require evidence + provenance + multi-source
corpus.note: The EvidenceContract would require evidence_ids and provenance_chain for VERIFIED status.

corpus.description: Audit field-level provenance of cross-linked internati data
corpus.finding: 4448/20465 (21.7%) internati have active cross-links. These fields were overwritten from external sources but appear as original data in the pipeline. No provenance distinction between original and cross-linked fields.
corpus.pass_criteria: Cross-linked fields should be marked as secondary evidence

corpus.description: Validate event ontology hierarchy in DB
corpus.finding: 29/49 events have parent_event_id set. 0 self-references, 29 invalid parent references. EventOntologyService (which would validate this) is NOT used by the pipeline.
corpus.pass_criteria: No cycles, no invalid parent references
corpus.note: Hierarchy data exists but is not validated through the service during pipeline execution.

corpus.description: Verify evidence_snapshots table is populated
corpus.finding: evidence_snapshots table exists but has 0 rows. _stage_persist() is a no-op (pass). No snapshots are ever saved. No evidence trail. No reproducibility.
corpus.pass_criteria: evidence_snapshots should have rows from pipeline runs

corpus.description: Quantify legacy data leakage through graph service
corpus.finding: Graph service shows all 1539685 event_links and 169184 record_links as 'to_review' (include_to_review=True by default). 261934 event_links and 152140 record_links have high confidence. usable_as_evidence=0 is NOT checked. Gated links appear with confidence labels.
corpus.pass_criteria: Gated links should not appear in graph output

corpus.description: Summary metrics for validation campaign
corpus.finding: 0/9 evidence-centric modules are in the V7 pipeline decision path. All 9 are implemented but unused. 4.1M+ legacy links exist with quarantine columns that are never checked. 2.3M collegamenti have NO quarantine columns at all.
corpus.pass_criteria: All modules should be in decision path
